tool_events.result:
Answer only from these help center sections. End your answer with the article title it came from, for example: (Source: Disputing a transaction)

Source: Verifying your identity > If verification doesn't work
If the details you provide don't match our records, you can try again. For your security, identity verification in chat is locked after three unsuccessful attempts. If this happens, call Tidewell Bank support at 1-800-555-0199, Monday to Friday, 8am to 8pm.

Source: Privacy and security > If you think your account was accessed without permission
If you think someone accessed your account without permission, freeze your card in chat and call Tidewell Bank support at 1-800-555-0199 right away. See "Fraud and scams" for more steps.

Source: Lost or stolen cards > Unfreezing or replacing a card
Cards can't be unfrozen or replaced through chat. To unfreeze a card or order a replacement card, call Tidewell Bank support at 1-800-555-0199, Monday to Friday, 8am to 8pm.

Source: Privacy and security > Keeping your information safe
Don't share your card details, PIN, or passwords with anyone, including people who say they work for Tidewell Bank. Use a strong, unique password for online banking.

Source: Fraud and scams > If you shared information with a scammer
If you shared your card details, PIN, password, or a passcode with someone, freeze your card and call Tidewell Bank support at 1-800-555-0199 immediately.
